acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: There is a lot of disinformation surrounding the 2020 presidential election. A few conspiracy theories in particular have gained traction. Host Ira Glass talks to some of the people at the center of those conspiracies.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Reporter Lizzie Johnson calls her grandpa after he unexpectedly changes his mind about something.
acts.title: The Signs, They are a Changin’

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Writer Emily Flake’s young daughter tries to make up her mind about whether or not she has a crush on a boy in her class. The way she goes about it surprises Emily.
acts.title: Puppy Love Triangle

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Reporter Jasmine Garsd grew up in Argentina watching talk shows which were kind of extreme even for Latin American television. The women on screen were pumped with silicone and Botox, and sometimes showed up wearing almost nothing. Recently one long-time host seemed to have a change of heart overnight. Jasmine went back to Argentina to find out what had happened.
This story is a collaboration with the NPR podcast Rough Translation.
acts.title: The All-Too-Real Housewives of Argentina
